title: Koil Killaz Salt E-Liquid – Blitz 30ml
description:
Description
Specifications
A truly magnificent blend of blueberries and watermelon, with a hint of pear.
Koil Killaz Salt is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Koil Killaz Salt E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
60% VG 40% PG
30ml
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Koil Killaz is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
